scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --raw "npm run dev --prefix apps/web -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3000" "npm run dev --prefix apps/api" "npm run dev --prefix apps/pocketbase -- --http=127.0.0.1:8090"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --raw "npm run start --prefix apps/api" "npm run start --prefix apps/pocketbase"
scripts.lint: concurrently --raw "npm run lint --prefix apps/web" "npm run lint --prefix apps/api"
scripts.ci: npm ci && npm run lint && npm run build
